tips.text: Farm Quartakk's blueprint in the same Ghoul Purge session.
Repeat the low-tier bounty; a run takes about a minute, and Rescue stages can chain two.
Use Wisp's teleport back to the tent to reset faster between bounties.
Bring Nekros to Olympus to double drops from the Ghoul flood.
Skip Resource Drop Chance Boosters and Smeeta Kavat; they do not help weapon or mod drops.
Keep the Defector away from Thumpers, or slow enemies with Zenurik's Temporal Drag.
Craft the Coprite Alloy while you wait for the next Ghoul Purge.
Players treat the Stubba and Quartakk as Mastery fodder, not weapons worth farming for power.
